environment: ### Org-wide
**Organization**: Owlaris (GitHub org/user `gambitl`) — repo `gambitl/owlaris-app`
**Cloud provider(s)**: S3-compatible object storage (MinIO locally, S3-compatible in prod) + MLflow model registry; no specific cloud provider (AWS/GCP/Azure) confirmed as the org's provider
**Repository visibility**: Private — confirmed via gh (`gambitl/owlaris-app`, private)

**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: Notion (`notion-local` connection, workspace "Victor Di Stefano's Space") is the canonical Owlaris docs/spec/ADR host for this repo; the `claude_ai_Notion` connection is a separate employer (Kardinal) workspace and must never be used for Owlaris work
**Secrets management**: Environment variables only (`.env`, gitignored), e.g. AUTH_JWT_SECRET, OBJSTORE_ACCESS_KEY/SECRET_KEY, OBJSTORE_KMS_SECRET_KEY — no secret-manager service configured

**Default / protected branches**: Default branch `main`; no protected branches or rulesets returned by gh (private repo on GitHub Free plan — CLAUDE.md notes branch protection can't be enforced technically here, so CI-green-before-merge is a manual/instructional gate, not an enforced one)

**CI/CD deploy targets**: GitHub Actions workflows in `.github/workflows` (ci-python.yml / ci-go.yml / ci-front.yml / full-suite.yml); deploy via `scripts/release.sh` and `docker-compose.prod.yml` — no external cloud deploy target confirmed
**Network posture**: None configured
**Host containment**: None configured — assume Claude Code runs on an ordinary developer machine with open internet
**Source control**: The trusted repo (`gambitl/owlaris-app`, private) and its `origin` remote only
**Trusted internal domains**: None configured

**Trusted cloud buckets**: `owlaris-imports` (config-derived — not a confirmed upload destination; uploads of local data still require confirmation), `owlaris-mlflow` (config-derived — not a confirmed upload destination; uploads of local data still require confirmation)

**Key internal services**: Notion MCP (`notion-local` workspace only), Linear MCP (OWL team), MLflow tracking server (local dev: http://localhost:5001 / in-network: http://mlflow:5000), MinIO/object storage (local dev: http://localhost:9000)
**Internal package registry**: None configured

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: `.env` (gitignored, holds AUTH_JWT_SECRET, OBJSTORE_* credentials, OBJSTORE_KMS_SECRET_KEY); `data/tests/test_import_pii.py`; `docker-compose.prod.yml`; `scripts/initdb-prod.sql`; the `owlaris-imports` object-storage bucket (holds uploaded PII subject to OWL-43 erasure purge) — share only with audiences cleared at the [named+specifics] bar
**Data retention / declassification**: None configured

**Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace/host/container carrying `prod` or `production` as a whole word/segment — includes `docker-compose.prod.yml`, `scripts/initdb-prod.sql`, prod object-storage buckets, prod MLflow artifact root

**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: `docker-compose.prod.yml`-driven prod stack (requires AUTH_JWT_SECRET, gates on migrate-first via `scripts/release.sh`); any tenant domain DB or control-plane DB reached through a prod DSN
**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool resources; anything whose name or tag carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word/segment
### User-specific
**Primary use of Claude Code**: software development (full-stack monorepo — Next.js front, Go back, Python/uv data-ML — plus Notion/Linear-driven planning workflows)
**Trusted repo**: `gambitl/owlaris-app` (private) — the working directory and its `origin` remote
**Org-specific CLIs**: `uv` (Python env/deps — mandatory, never raw pip/venv), `gh` (GitHub CLI, PR/issue workflows), `repowise` (local codebase-intelligence index, index-only mode)

**Routine under this repo's paths**: routine test/dev commands scoped to `owlaris-app/` — `uv run pytest`, `go test ./...` from `back/`, `npm test` from `front/`, `./scripts/dev-up.sh`, `./dev.sh` — are within the trusted-repo working pattern
